name: Client access protocols per mailbox
description: Shows, for each mailbox, whether POP, IMAP, MAPI, EWS, ActiveSync, Outlook on the web and SMTP client authentication are allowed, with the organisation's SMTP AUTH setting and the effective SMTP AUTH result.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Mailboxes
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to check every mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: When no mailbox is named, stops after this many and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients and the organisation transport configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
A mailbox whose SMTP client authentication setting is returned empty follows the organisation setting and is shown as FollowsOrganisation; one not returned at all is Unknown.
Authentication policies, Conditional Access and security defaults can also block a protocol or basic authentication; they are not read, so an enabled protocol here is not proof that sign-in succeeds.
When no mailbox is named, mailboxes are read up to the limit plus one and the result is marked partial when there are more.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
